title: September 2025: LaTeX support, OneDrive integration, and Sparky can edit images!
summary: Flint’s September update adds LaTeX math support, OneDrive integration, and AI image editing, making teaching simpler and smarter.
body_markdown:
Teachers can now add beautifully formatted equations into their documents with built-in LaTeX support.


-


Click the equation icon to write with LaTeX directly in Flint.


-


Export equations to Word or Google Docs with perfect formatting.


-


Use **compact mode** to shrink the calculator into a draggable window—perfect for multitasking while you create worksheets and lessons.
